items.item_text: Bachelors degree required
Advanced degree preferred.
Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressively responsible leadership experience in government relations, public affairs, legislative affairs, advocacy, or related fields.
Experience working within a highly regulated industry required; healthcare experience strongly preferred.
Significant experience representing large, complex organizations before state legislatures, governors offices, regulatory agencies, trade associations, and coalition partners.
Proven experience advising senior executives and influencing executive-level decision making on complex legislative, political, reputational, and business issues.
Experience working within highly matrixed organizations and leading through influence across multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Demonstrated experience managing external lobbying firms, trade association strategies, coalition partnerships, and external consultants across multiple jurisdictions.

Lead Kaiser Permanentes enterprise state government relations strategy and leads and manages a team of market-based Government Relations leaders to advance shared legislative, political, and business priorities.

Design, implement, and continuously evolve a One KP state government relations operating model that aligns enterprise and market teams around shared priorities, establishes clear decision rights and governance, and enables coordinated execution across Kaiser Permanentes markets.

Serve as Kaiser Permanentes senior enterprise representative with governors, legislative leadership, state agencies, state trade associations, coalition partners, and other key stakeholders across current and future markets.

Build and execute proactive engagement strategies that strengthen Kaiser Permanentes visibility, credibility, and influence with policymakers and stakeholders, positioning the organization as a trusted healthcare leader and thought partner.

Oversee enterprise legislative intelligence, political analysis, stakeholder landscape assessments, and issue monitoring to identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks, and enterprise implications.

Develop and maintain a comprehensive enterprise legislative tracking, monitoring, and reporting capability that provides timely intelligence, analysis, issue forecasting, and executive-ready reporting to support decision-making and stakeholder activation across the organization.

Establish enterprise standards, tools, reporting, governance, and performance measures for legislative tracking, stakeholder engagement, coalition management, consultant oversight, and issue management to strengthen transparency, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.
Establish enterprise processes for issue management, forecasting, escalation, scenario planning, and executive reporting.

Monitor political, legislative, regulatory, and stakeholder environments in prospective growth markets and advise enterprise leaders regarding opportunities, risks, and market readiness considerations.

Partner closely with Permanente Medical Group leaders to align legislative priorities, leverage clinical expertise in support of engagement strategies, and identify opportunities for physician engagement that strengthen Kaiser Permanentes credibility and influence with policymakers and stakeholders.

Lead Kaiser Permanentes engagement with key state and multi-state trade associations and help shape industry priorities, coalition strategies, and legislative approaches that advance enterprise objectives.

Partner with Advocacy leadership to establish strategic priorities, define stakeholder mobilization requirements, and develop coordinated engagement strategies that advance legislative and political objectives.

Build and maintain relationships with national governors organizations, legislative leadership organizations, healthcare associations, and other influential stakeholder groups whose activities shape state legislative and political environments.

Identify emerging legislative, political, and stakeholder trends across markets and develop enterprise strategies to proactively address issues before they become business, reputational, operational, or regulatory challenges.
Develop and lead multi-market coalition strategies that advance Kaiser Permanentes priorities and strengthen the organizations influence with policymakers and external stakeholders.

Build a high-performing enterprise state government affairs capability by developing talent, modernizing tools and processes, fostering collaboration across markets, and establishing clear accountability for results.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise or multi-state legislative and stakeholder engagement strategies.
